Slop Music · In development

Music player

Play the audio in your Slop Drive. Nothing uploaded.

Open now

Slop Music has these main features: Library from Slop Drive, sorted and searchable; Playlists, tags and .splaylist files. It opens MP3, WAV, Ogg, FLAC, M4A, AAC, Opus.

In development: some features listed below may not be finished yet.

What you can do with Slop Music

  • Play your own music files in your browser
  • Play FLAC files in your browser
